title: Oh My MAGI deliberation and coordinator contracts
description: Closed JSON wire contracts for immutable deliberation snapshots, validated model outputs, commands, coordinator events, and recovery snapshots.

NegotiatedModeState.description: Observed ACP mode facility. Empty modes and null currentModeId attest absence; mode membership, uniqueness and ordering are validated by the domain.

AcpModelBindingSnapshot.description: Version matches its catalog. Version 1 omits mode evidence; version 2 carries observed mode evidence; version 3 additionally pins the verified runtime artifact set.

OpaqueId.description: Opaque application identifier. Rust additionally limits its UTF-8 byte length and rejects control characters.

ProviderProfileSummary.description: Renderer-safe profile summary; it omits runtime home identifiers, filesystem paths, secret references, and credential bytes.

CredentialHomeDisplay.description: Native-authoritative display path only; internal credential authority is excluded.

ProviderProfileDto.description: Renderer profile DTO with an optional credential display binding represented by null. No credential bytes, canonical authority, filesystem identifiers or account digests are exposed.
